items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1978-04-20
items.q: I would feel safer from the same, Carlton, than there in this case.

ctx.x: Yeah. That was named after a grocery store. As a matter of fact, I don't know if you've ever heard of that. Gyrkis or something like that. People mispronounce it. There was even a, I don't know if you've ever heard this, but used to have the record. I guess we, it was here in the public library. I cataloged it. Dave Bethan, he recorded something called Gyrk Town. Backed up with High Society. It's sort of a strange, it's sort of a strange combination of Dixieland. What people call Dixieland now, with more modern…
I would feel safer from the same, Carlton, than there in this case.
Yeah. Well, what about school? Did you play in bands at school?
